name: app-shell
title: App Shell
description: The operations page shell: a persistent sidebar, a toolbar, and panes that scroll inside a fixed viewport.
docs: Use for a screen operated by someone, under data-design="operations". Compose AppShell > AppShellSidebar (put a nav inside, laid out as a column) + AppShellToolbar + AppShellPanes > AppShellPane (give each an aria-label). From md the viewport is fixed and panes scroll, and the toolbar's controls go compact on a desktop mouse. Below md the page scrolls and the sidebar hides: render the same nav in a Sheet (side="left") opened from a menu Button first in the toolbar, as examples/operations-queue.tsx does. Panes butt against each other on hairlines: no gap, no elevation. A presentation screen uses PageCanvas instead. See DESIGN.md "Profiles".
